# Billy

## Overview

- **Age:** twenty  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Billy is a twenty-year-old youth who is described as big and fat. He has a round, expressionless face and maintains a stolid appearance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Billy possesses a strong aversion to high society and formal social gatherings. He exhibits a mortal fear of being invited to suppers with wealthy strangers, often choosing to vanish or flee rather than face such engagements.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_

## Traits

- mortal fear of invitations to formal suppers with wealthy strangers  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## History

Billy attended a charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) alongside other guests. Following the performance and subsequent supper, he drove [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) back home under the moonlight. During the drive, the group conversed about the evening's compliments, wealth, and their contentment with their lives.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P7](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P8](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy--jane-andrews.md)

[Jane](../character/jane.md) is Billy's sister, and the two siblings travel together by buggy. Following the charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), Billy drives [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) home under the moonlight. During the ride, [Jane](../character/jane.md) and the other passengers discuss the evening's compliments, wealth, and their own contentment with life.

- Sibling of — brother and sister who travel together in their buggy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>
